name: Basic medical knowledge error
definition: having incorrect knowledge about the mechanism of medicine, immunology, disease mechanism, etc. (which leads to poor decisions)

name: Diagnostic error
definition: making incorrect diagnostic conclusions from the patient's condition.

name: Treatment and test method suggestion error
definition: suggesting wrong treatment method or wrong test method for the patient's disease.

name: Other
definition: making math mistakes in questions that require math, doing well on a question but picking the wrong answer, etc.

name: Prioritization error
definition: misjudging the level of urgency or giving unnecessary prescriptions.

name: Basic medical knowledge error
definition: having incorrect medical knowledge which leads to poor decisions.

name: Self-logic error
definition: having logical flaw in response. For example, a student may fail to show logical consistency, such as self-refuting his or her own words. Or the student may skip intermediate steps in his or her logical development.

name: Arbitrary information assumption error
definition: arbitrarily assuming (explicitly or implicitly) information that is not given in the question.

name: Ignoring key clue
definition: ignoring important information given in the question that is essential to derive the correct answer.

name: Calculation and statistical interpretation error
definition: making miscalculations or mistakes in the interpretation of statistical data.

name: Other
definition: errors that do not fall into any of the above categories.
